subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the broad Control UI zh-CN tab-localization tracker while sequencing the focused tab PRs, or narrow it and move broader docs/runtime localization to separate issues?
rationale: Current main still has source-reproducible English UI copy, but multiple overlapping PRs and the docs-site follow-up make the remaining scope a product/review-sequencing decision rather than a safe standalone automation task.

options.title: Keep broad UI tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring focused PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

options.title: Narrow to original tabs
options.body: Limit this issue to Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, and Debug, and route Settings, chat metadata, docs, CLI, and runtime localization to linked issues.

options.title: Supersede into broader localization program
options.body: Move the remaining work to a larger localization-coverage issue only after choosing a viable canonical tracker and preserving these tab-specific findings.

recommendation.title: Keep broad UI tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring focused PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest current-main routing signal from the blame and merged PR metadata for the affected Control UI/i18n files.
